key: tests/evals/swarm.eval.ts › Swarm evals — a live measured search through the settled tool surface > MEASURED: a live swarm crowns a winner that beats its own measured baseline
reason: needs a live model BY DEFINITION: it drives agents({action:'swarm'}) through the real tool surface and grades the tree on the caller's own exec-ratio verifier — a winner crowned, its artifact measured against the run's own measured baseline, exploration_records rows reachable under the objective's key, and the judgeEnsemble/fanIn/carry disclosures consistent with the axes in force. A mock model writes whatever the fixture scripts, so 'did a real search beat the reference' is not a question one can answer. It is IN-PROCESS by nature — it reads the tool's own return value over a CLIRuntime, which a deployed workspace does not hand out — so under KINU_EVAL_BACKEND=cloud it skips and prints that reason rather than measuring the local loop under a cloud banner. The credential-free half of the same file — the action is offered, and the strict parse refuses an unknown field naming the field it meant — runs at every tier, and the engine's own tree, arbiter, DAG and records behaviour is covered credential-free at packages/core/tests/unit-swarm-depth.test.ts. Runs in the eval tier's own live swarm arm, which is held to its own liveness assertion.

reason: needs a live model BY DEFINITION: it sends one real user turn asking the agent to run a search, then grades what the workspace RECORDED — the step count and last-step finish reason against the run_end reason, and the five search-ledger reads that establish whether any node spawned. A mock model reaches the rung only if the fixture scripts it, so 'did the agent choose the search through the loop it actually runs on' is unanswerable without a real one. It is the TARGET-AGNOSTIC arm, and the only one in this suite: it provisions its OWN workspace through resolveEvalTarget, so the same test drives the in-process cli-backend runtime under KINU_EVAL_BACKEND=local and a real staging workspace under =cloud — the only way in this tree to reach @cloudflare/think — the loop that carries the stepCountIs(10) cap this arm's step-count assertion exists to surface, and which no suite in this tree could previously enter. Runs in the eval tier: `bun run test:eval` (local) or `bun run evals:cloud`.

key: tests/evals/trajectory.eval.ts › Trajectory evals — multi-turn episodes through the public API > MEASURED: public-file-artifact
reason: needs BOTH a live model AND the deployed public API: this case drives a multi-turn episode through the surfaces the WEB CLIENT speaks — `POST /api/user/workspaces`, the agents-SDK chat frames on the workspace socket, the public run-event and file routes, and `removeWorkspace` on the way out — so it can only run under `KINU_EVAL_BACKEND=cloud` against a deployment. `resolvePublicSessionPlan` refuses every other backend before it consults a credential and prints the remedy, and the browser plane needs the deployment's own synthetic-identity secret (KINU_EVAL_WEB_IDENTITY) which the tier's CLI bearer cannot substitute for. The frame codec, the ledger bridge and the skip remedies are covered credential-free in tests/evals/public-session.test.ts, and the corpus/admissibility/degenerate-refusal properties in the same file as this case.

key: tests/evals/device.eval.ts › Device evals — one machine, linked and driven through the deployed API > MEASURED: device-connect-e2e
reason: needs a DEPLOYMENT and this machine: the case links the host it runs on to the target through `connectDevice` — registering the device, installing the daemon the CLI ships under a throwaway KINU_HOME, and starting it — then reads `GET /api/cli/devices`, grants a workspace consent through `PUT /api/user/devices/:id/consent`, runs one command on the machine through `executeInExecutor('laptop', …)`, revokes the device and checks the next command refuses with a class. No in-process runtime has a device plane to link to, so `KINU_EVAL_BACKEND=cloud` is the only backend that can run it, and `deviceArmGate` skips every other one before it consults a credential. Under cloud a missing credential is a FAILURE rather than this skip: the arm needs both the CLI bearer (for /api/cli/devices) and the deployment's synthetic-identity secret KINU_EVAL_WEB_IDENTITY (for the consent and revoke routes). It calls NO model, so the tier gives it `self` liveness instead of holding it to model spend. Runs in the eval tier: `bun run evals:cloud`.
